title: Giant 'see-through' UFO caught on camera over Oregon before vanishing
excerpt: An eyewitness testimony posted to the National UFO Reporting Center described the mysterious object as 'silver in color with a distorted, see-through surface.
content:
A family was left shaken when a ‘see-through’ UFO shone bright lights through a bedroom window at their Oregon home before vanishing. 

An eyewitness testimony posted to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC) described the mysterious object as 'silver in color with a distorted, see-through surface, two really big lights and no distinct shape.'

The report states the incident began around 8pm at a home in Wilsonville, with the eyewitness, labeled as 'S,' stating that she was sitting on their back patio when it happened.

'I noticed what looked like something I’ve never seen fall out of the sky. Almost like a bird was shot dead in the air and plummeted,' S told NUFORC.

'The object went from looking rectangular to a large ball, then a small ball in a matter of a blink. I pointed out to my partner and daughter, “there’s something falling out of the sky!”'

The report explains the 12-year-old girl fled her bedroom at 9.14pm, as bright lights flashed throughout the room.  When the parents ran into the room, they saw a giant object floating outside the window with lights pointing inside.

'Thankfully, my 12-year-old was able to get a pic of it while it was happening,' S said. 

S reported that after the sighting she felt 'nauseous' with 'balance issues,' while her daughter experienced intermittent headaches throughout the night. Both of them felt better the next day. 

An image of the mysterious object was taken by the 12-year-old daughter who said it flew close to her bedroom window and blasted a beam of light

 The incident happened on August 25, 2026, with S reporting it to NUFORC the same day.

She told NUFORC investigator Keith Bickford that the object was rectangular and fell from the night sky as if 'shot out of thin air.'

Shortly after the object fell, according to the report, it quickly shape-shifted into a 'giant ball' that had a 'peculiar' stream behind it. 

'It had a stream following behind it what looked like smoke? But not smoke,' said S. 

S, her partner and daughter ran back to the room, finding 'this big object floating still pointed directly towards' their home.

 'It hovered there for almost a minute and then just disappeared! My daughter was looking at it before she got us and said it looked like it was see-through silver when it got close,' the eyewitness stated.

The daughter said she was the first to spot the object and shouted for her parents to come and look. 

She described it as being as wide as three airplanes, with what appeared to be its nose tilted upward. 

NUFORC shared another mysterious incident in October, featuring testimony from pilots who were flying over Ohio when they spotted a strange object near their plane, only to be told nothing was registering on radar 

Bickford wrote in the report: 'I contacted two farmers with property in the area and both used drones day and night for crop care, but none of the drones were close to the size stated in this report. 

'Both the Clackamas County Sheriff's Office and the Wilsonville Police Department had no UAP or UFO reports for that evening. FlightRadar24 showed nothing. I am classifying this as an anomalous sighting.' 

NUFORC shared another mysterious incident in October, featuring testimony from pilots flying over Ohio when they spotted a strange object near their plane, only to be told nothing was registering on radar.

One pilot captured a photograph of the object, which he described during a follow-up interview with NUFORC investigator Ben Hansen. The encounter occurred on August 16.

‘The surface was silver and highly reflective, like pure polished metal,’ reads the investigator’s report, which identified the pilot only as ‘J.’

‘J described the UAP as uniform, pill-shaped. There were no warps or creases on the surface, nor was it tapered at the bottom,' Hansen wrote.

NUFORC shared a CGI recreation of the pill-shaped UFO based on the witness's description

The crew saw no other aircraft on their collision-warning system or flight-tracking app. According to the report, Cleveland Center air traffic controllers also told them no aircraft or unidentified objects were showing on radar.

J believed the object may have emerged from thunderstorm clouds the pilots were attempting to fly between.

He questioned whether a balloon could have survived those conditions, reporting that their own aircraft experienced engine icing and moderate turbulence after entering the clouds.

The NUFORC confirmed the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) did not detect an object on radar and found no database matches for planned balloon launches.

'Coupled with the witness’s estimate that the object was at least 30 feet in height and uniformly shaped without tapering at the top or bottom, it presents some challenges to the balloon theory,' Hansen said in the report.
